Through-hole parts: J3 (HR911105A), J4 (AF 90 WJDG), J5 (B-2100S40P-B110), J6 (1x3P 2.54mm) are placed and soldered **by JLC** (THT service, 63 plated joints per board); the USB-C J1 is an SMD part with 4 plated shell pegs, also soldered by JLC: 67 manual joints per board, 134 for 2 boards as costed. Nothing is left for you to hand-solder.

**Remark to paste** (PCB + assembly):

> Panel by customer: board 80 x 80 mm with 5 mm edge rails on the left and right (total 90 x 80 mm). Please V-cut along the two lines in file rv1106-reva-V-CUT.gbr (x = 5.00 mm and x = 85.00 mm from the panel's left edge, full height, zero gap) to remove the rails; do not add more rails. Fiducials and 2.0 mm tooling holes are on the rails. Via covering: epoxy filled and capped (via-in-pad) for all vias, incl. the 16 vias in the U9 exposed pad. U9 is a 0.35 mm-pitch QFN-128: please use a 0.10 mm stencil. Board corners have 1.5 x 1.5 mm routed notches with R 0.5 mm inner corners.

## 4. Check before paying (JLC's DFM and parts preview)

1. **RV1106G3 (C5328706) stock >= 4** (2 boards + 2, D-H2). It was 23 on 2026-10-29. If lower, do not order.
2. **POFV price** on the 4-layer quote (UNVERIFIED; not in the cost estimate below). JLC's DFM must keep all 670 vias filled + capped, including the 16 EP vias (they are real board vias since D-119).
3. **Router bit** for the four 1.5 × 1.5 mm rail notches with R 0.5 mm inner corners (needs a bit <= 1.0 mm; UNVERIFIED, D-117 h / D-118 c). If the DFM flags it, accept a larger inner radius only on the rail side.
4. **V-cut** is read from the V-CUT file / remark (UNVERIFIED how JLC wants it); the DFM view must show two cuts at 5 mm from each side, nothing else.
5. **Every CPL rotation**: open the 3-D / assembly preview and tick the 31 rows of `cpl-rotations.md` (pin 1 / cathode / + position). The SOT-23 / QFN / SON / CP corrections are UNVERIFIED community values.
6. **THT parts** J3, J4, J5, J6 appear in the parts list (THT assembly) and the USB-C J1 pegs are soldered.
7. **No part 'not matched'**: the BOM has 63 LCSC numbers; any part JLC cannot source stops the order (replace only after a team review).
8. **Fixture fee / pre-reflow fee**: cost.md counts the fixture ($16.42) and not the pre-reflow fee (see below).
9. RV1106G3 is MSL3 ([DS] r1.8 p.18); how JLC bakes MSL3 parts is UNVERIFIED.

Numbers from `design/tools/check_bom.py design` run by this script on today's bom.csv (cost.md still shows the pre-D-117 c figure $373.34 with 64 part types; the BOM now has 63).

| Item | USD | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Parts (63 unique, 24 Extended) | 112.81 | LCSC ladder prices fetched 2026-10-29 (cost.md) |
| Assembly: setup 25.56, stencil 8.21, 1164 SMT joints 1.86, 134 THT joints 5.78, feeder loading 96.39, X-ray 9.84, fixture 16.42, packing 0.50, confirm placement 0.45 | 165.01 | price page 2026-10-28 |
| PCB, 5 pcs, 4-layer, 90 × 80 mm, ENIG | 58.00 | **ESTIMATE** (no live quote) |
| Shipping | 35.00 | **ESTIMATE** |
| **Total (check_bom)** | **370.82** | margin 9.18 to the cap |
| POFV (epoxy-filled, capped vias) on 4 layers | not costed | **UNVERIFIED**: chosen by D-H6 after the estimate; if it costs more than $9.18 the total exceeds $380 |
| Pre-reflow soldering fee (if charged) | 0 to 21 | UNVERIFIED (cost.md §1) |

So the order stays within the cap only if the live PCB + POFV + shipping price is <= $102.18 (58.00 + 35.00 + 9.18). If the live total exceeds $380, stop: the cap is the owner's rule.

## 6. Do not

- **Never run 'Update footprints from library'** (or 'Update PCB from schematic' with footprint replacement) on this board: 152 footprints were edited on purpose (silk widths, trimmed silk, U9 `_EPboardvias` variant without drilled EP pads, D-117 i, D-129). It would bring back the U9 ComponentDrill pads and undo the silk fixes. Rebuild only with `design/pcb/scripts/rebuild_all.sh`.
- Do not hand-edit anything in `design/pcb/fab/`: run `sh design/pcb/scripts/l6_run.sh` again.
- Depanel by breaking the rails off with pliers close to the V-cut, not by bending the board (layout.md §8).
